title: Fast walkers exempt from FOIA; Defense Support Program detections

tellings.quote: you to this day you cannot use the freedom of information act on fast walkers. You know uh John Greenwald tried to do that.

plain: "Fast walkers", the name for fast-moving objects picked up by US military early-warning satellites high above the Earth, are said to be off limits to this day under the Freedom of Information Act, a US law that lets anyone request government records. Michels tells this himself and says a records researcher named John Greenewald Jr. tried to get such files and could not. If true, it would mean the government keeps these satellite sightings unusually secret.
